title: The Weather Today
text:
Today the weather is very bad. It is cold and it is raining. The sky is grey. I like sunny days more.

Yesterday was hot and sunny. We went to the park. The sun was bright and the sky was blue. Tomorrow it will be windy.

questions.text: What is the weather like today?
Where did the speaker go yesterday?
How does the speaker probably feel about the weather today?
What can we guess about the sky yesterday?

vocabulary.definition: when water falls from the sky in drops
with a lot of bright sunshine

paragraph_translations: Сьогодні дуже погана погода. Холодно і йде дощ. Небо сіре. Мені більше подобаються сонячні дні.
Вчора було спекотно і сонячно. Ми пішли в парк. Сонце було яскравим, а небо блакитним. Завтра буде вітряно.
